title_original: ‘Hexed’ European Premiere Photos: Hailee Steinfeld, Jodie Foster, Rashida Jones & More

blocks.text: The voice cast of Hexed reunited in Europe over the weekend for premieres in London and Paris.
Hailee Steinfeld, Rashida Jones and Jodie Foster were among the stars who walked the red carpet.

Hexed follows an impulsive and unconventional teenage girl named Billie (Steinfeld) who discovers secret magical abilities which, once unleashed, hurtle her out of suburbia and into a spectacle-filled journey through a vast witch realm.
Forced to team up with her cautious mother, Alice (Jones), they uncover family mysteries that could change the world of witches forever.
Scroll through the gallery below to see photos from both events.
